title: A Big Win: Feelings & Linking Words

scenes.t: {name} reads about Omar. Omar was nervous before his first football match.
When the match started, he was worried about making mistakes.
But after he scored a goal, Omar felt proud of himself.
He was happy when his team won the game.
Linking words: 'when' tells the time something happens, 'but' shows a change, 'after' tells what comes next.
Write about your feelings: I felt happy when I received a gift.

items.a: A bit scared before something new.
Omar was nervous when the match started.
After he scored, he felt proud.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the verb with its past form.

items.q: Omar (is / was) nervous before the match.
Omar was nervous ___ the match started.
___ he scored a goal, he felt proud.
He was worried, ___ he didn't stop.

o: He scored a goal and felt proud.
He scored a goal and felt proud?
he scored a goal and felt proud

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 78–81
